name: message-list
summary: A conversation: the messages in order in a labeled, scrolling region that opens at the newest one and announces each new message from someone else once.

properties.name: label
properties.description: What the conversation is, spoken: "Conversation with Ouro".

properties.name: jumpLabel
properties.description: The button that appears once the reader scrolls up, for other languages.

properties.name: hasOlder
properties.description: Older messages can be loaded: a button above the first message asks for them.

properties.name: olderLabel
properties.description: The load-older button's name, for other languages.

slots.name: messages
slots.description: The messages, one per line as "id: author | time | text | mine" (mine is optional and marks the person's own, which are never announced).

events.name: newMessage
events.description: A message from someone else arrived while the list is in use; the list announces "author: text" once, politely. History the list mounts with is never announced.

states.name: rest
states.description: The newest message in view; a short conversation sits at the bottom.

states.name: focused
states.description: The platform's focus ring on the jump and load-older buttons.

accessibility.name: The group's label; each message is read as Message does, in the order sent.
accessibility.keyboard: Messages are read in order; Tab reaches the load-older and jump buttons, which appear only when they apply.
accessibility.web: A region named by its label, with a separate polite live region for each new message.
accessibility.apple: A container with a label whose messages are elements in order; a new message posts one polite announcement.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.List named by its label, its items ListItems in order; a new message raises one UIA notification with Importance=Other (polite, as the web's).
accessibility.android: A container with a collection role named by its label, its items in order, and a polite live region for each new message; the buttons have click actions.

slots.messages: a: Ana | 9:41 | See you at noon.; b: You | 9:42 | On my way. | mine

cases.person: Two messages in order, Ana's on the leading side and yours on the trailing side, the newest in view.
A Load older messages button above one message.

deviations: Web has no load-older button, olderLabel or loadOlder event: hasOlder only reserves room above the first message and a status line says older messages are loading. The native load-older button is a native-only addition.
Web also windows long histories, follows streaming text and takes a conversation key; native kits use their platform's lazy list and follow the same read-once rule.
Web announces through its own live region; native kits use the platform's announcement (UIA notification, live-region semantics).

windows.type: Ouro.UI.Windows.OuroMessageList, a templated WinUI Control; not yet built

android.type: bot.ouro.ui.hx.OuroMessageList, in Jetpack Compose (ourostack/ouro-ui-android); not yet built
